title: Snow globe
svg:
<svg viewBox='0 0 100 100' xmlns='http://www.w3.org/2000/svg'>
  <defs>
    <radialGradient id='globeGrad' cx='38%' cy='35%' r='70%'>
      <stop offset='0%' stop-color='#bfe9ff' stop-opacity='0.55'/>
      <stop offset='70%' stop-color='#7fc9f0' stop-opacity='0.35'/>
      <stop offset='100%' stop-color='#4ea8d8' stop-opacity='0.55'/>
    </radialGradient>
  </defs>
  <!-- base of snow globe -->
  <ellipse cx='50' cy='84' rx='27' ry='7' fill='#8a5232'/>
  <path d='M23 84 Q23 76 27 72 L73 72 Q77 76 77 84 Z' fill='#b8763f'/>
  <path d='M27 72 Q50 66 73 72 L73 76 Q50 70 27 76 Z' fill='#e6a25c'/>
  <ellipse cx='50' cy='83' rx='23' ry='5' fill='#c98a4b' opacity='0.6'/>
  <!-- glass globe -->
  <circle cx='50' cy='45' r='33' fill='url(#globeGrad)'/>
  <!-- snow ground inside -->
  <path d='M22 68 Q30 58 42 60 Q52 56 60 61 Q70 57 78 67 Q66 74 50 74 Q34 74 22 68 Z' fill='#f2f8ff'/>

  <!-- tiny snowman details: hat and scarf -->
  <path d='M47 46 L53 46 L53 43 L47 43 Z' fill='#e05050'/>
  <path d='M46.5 43 L53.5 43' stroke='#e05050' stroke-width='2' stroke-linecap='round'/>
  <path d='M46 48 Q50 50 54 48' stroke='#47b04a' stroke-width='2' fill='none' stroke-linecap='round'/>

  <circle cx='32' cy='30' r='1.6' fill='#ffffff'/>

  <circle cx='70' cy='46' r='1.5' fill='#ffffff'/>
  <circle cx='28' cy='48' r='1.3' fill='#ffffff'/>
  <circle cx='62' cy='62' r='1.2' fill='#ffffff'/>
  <circle cx='36' cy='64' r='1.4' fill='#ffffff'/>
  <circle cx='74' cy='34' r='1.2' fill='#ffffff'/>
  <circle cx='24' cy='38' r='1.2' fill='#ffffff'/>
  <!-- glass shine -->
  <path d='M30 28 Q36 20 46 18' stroke='#ffffff' stroke-width='3' fill='none' stroke-linecap='round' opacity='0.85'/>
